descriere:
Banca Comerciala Română (BCR), membră a Erste Group, este cel unul dintre cele mai importante grupuri financiare din România, ce oferă servicii de bancă universală, leasing, pensii private, fonduri de investiții și produse de economisire-creditare pentru locuinţe, prin intermediul reţelei naționale de sucursale și centre de afaceri. Misiunea BCR este de a contribui la crearea de prosperitate pentru România, sprijinind șansele tuturor la o viață mai bună și susținându-le încrederea în forțele proprii și în capacitatea de a-și atinge potențialul. Pentru aceasta, BCR investește constant în acces sigur și facil la servicii financiare, banking pe înțelesul tuturor, consiliere financiară pe termen lung și produse care respectă potențialul fiecărui client. BCR a creat cel mai amplu și consistent program de educație financiară din România, “Școala de Bani”, prin cursuri pentru adulți și tineri, o expoziție mobilă de educație financiară pentru copii și o platformă digitală dedicată, toate acestea prin implicarea a peste 1.000 de profesori de educație financiară, experți ai BCR. In perspectiva viitorului si a digitalizarii serviciilor financiare, BCR a adus în România cea mai populară platformă bancară din Europa Centrala – George – primul produs fintech oferit de o bancă din România: creat la Viena într-un hub digital, cu contribuția tinerilor IT-iști români.
About our team BCR is the place where you learn, grow, and contribute to shaping the future of banking. We are recognized as a school of excellence in banking, a top employer in the banking sector, and a team open to learning, where every colleague feels noticed and valued. We are an organization that values people and supports them in having a life that brings fulfilment, security, and balance.How you will contribute Participate in assessing the feasibility of business requirements for changes to the information systems managed by the team, defining functional and technical solutions and ensuring the delivery of specifications aligned with business needs; Analyze and define technical solutions for payment processing applications, covering SEPA, Instant Payments, international payments and related payment services. Supervise technical activities within BCR projects related to the development and enhancement of applications supporting domestic, SEPA, instant and international payment services; Coordinate and monitor the technical activities and deliverables of external suppliers, ensuring alignment with the technical development strategy, internal procedures, methodologies, and agreed project plans; Prepare the technical documentation and deliverables required for deploying changes to business parameters and system configurations into the production environment; Provide functional analysis and technical support to operational teams, directly or through external suppliers, in identifying and resolving software defects during both implementation and production stages; Define and coordinate testing activities for new or modified functionalities, including test plans, scripts, scenarios, test environments, and test data requirements, ensuring functional testing and UAT readiness; Ensure proper technical documentation of the information systems under the teams responsibility, identify potential risks, and collaborate with other IT teams to design and implement integrated solutions across multiple applications; Perform any other tasks related to the role, as assigned by the direct manager, in accordance with applicable legal provisions. Investigate production incidents, perform root cause analysis and coordinate resolution activities with internal teams and external vendors. What will help you be successful Bachelors degree or higher in Automation, Computer Science, or another IT-related field, complemented by relevant IT training and professional development courses; Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience, including at least 1 year in a financial or banking institution and 1 year in application design and development; Knowledge of banking information systems, applications, products, and services, with an understanding of banking business processes; Experience in analyzing payment messages, transaction lifecycles and banking integration flows is considered a strong advantage. Understanding of functional and technical analysis, software development processes, application lifecycle management, testing methodologies, and technical documentation; Advanced level of English, with strong written and verbal communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills; Strong analytical and conceptual thinking, attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, creativity, and the ability to identify risks and propose effective solutions; Excellent organizational, prioritization, and time management skills, with the ability to adapt to change, manage ambiguity and stress, work under pressure, collaborate effectively with different teams and external suppliers, and independently manage responsibilities and competing priorities. Sounds like youd be a good fit? Check out what we provide for our people Monthly budget for flexible benefits through the Benefit Online platform; Performance-based bonus; Banking facilities, benefits for private pension and discounts on insurance policies; Gifts for special occasions; Private medical services for you and your family; Hybrid and flexible work schedule; Up to 27 vacation days depending on your professional experience; Extra 7 days off per year if you have used up your vacation days; One day off for your birthday; Wellbeing, personal and professional development programs, and platforms that allow you to learn anytime, anywhere, and from any device; Subscription to Bookster.
